### Motion

type Motion = Readonly<{
  reduced: boolean;

  springDuration: number;
  bounce: number;
  stretch: number;

Resolved, element-scoped motion. Times are milliseconds and distances pixels.

### motionTime()

```ts
function motionTime(motion, authored): number;
```

Scale one of a component's authored durations by the theme's tempo
(`--stipe-motion-normal` against its 180ms default). Today's themes return the
authored value unchanged; reduced motion returns 0 (nothing travels).

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                |
| ---------- | ------------------- |
| `motion`   | [`Motion`](#motion) |
| `authored` | `number`            |

#### Returns

`number`

---

### motionBounce()

```ts
function motionBounce(motion, authored): number;
```

Scale one of a component's authored spring bounces by the theme's bounce
(`--stipe-motion-bounce` against its 0.3 default), so a lively control stays
livelier than a calm one inside every theme. A 0 theme is critically damped.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                |
| ---------- | ------------------- |
| `motion`   | [`Motion`](#motion) |
| `authored` | `number`            |

#### Returns

`number`
